stem.text: The fatty acids elaidic acid and oleic acid have exactly the same structural formulae, with one double bond in the chain. However, the shapes of the chains are different, as shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of a long fatty acid chain with a COOH group at the top end and a double bond in the chain, labelled elaidic acid.
stem.label: elaidic acid

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of a long fatty acid chain with a COOH group at the top end and a double bond in the chain, labelled oleic acid.
stem.label: oleic acid

stem.text: Which row shows the effect of the presence of these fatty acids on the structure and behaviour of a cell surface membrane?

A.text: does not fit closely with other fatty acids so that the membrane is less fluid at high temperatures; fits closely with other fatty acids so that the membrane is less fluid at low temperatures

B.text: does not fit closely with other fatty acids so that the membrane is more fluid at low temperatures; fits closely with other fatty acids so that the membrane is less fluid at low temperatures

C.text: fits closely with other fatty acids so that the membrane is less fluid at high temperatures; does not fit closely with other fatty acids so that the membrane is more fluid at low temperatures

D.text: fits closely with other fatty acids so that the membrane is more fluid at low temperatures; does not fit closely with other fatty acids so that the membrane is more fluid at high temperatures
